articles.title: Why this investment bank expects little demand for tokenized stocks despite SEC’s new trading rules
articles.snippet: TD Cowen expects limited demand for tokenized stocks despite new SEC rules opening a path for trading outside traditional markets.

articles.title: Crypto political group plans to spend $30 million against Sherrod Brown's Senate bid
articles.snippet: It's the biggest spending from the industry's campaign arm in 2026, much like Fairshake's $40 million against Brown two years ago was its largest-ever outlay.

articles.title: Perp futures linked to 'bitcoin VIX' debut on Hyperliquid
articles.snippet: Deployed via Kinetiq's Markets frontend and led by Volmex CEO Cole Kennelly, Hyperliquid's new BVIV perpetuals let traders easily go long or short on 30-day bitcoin volatility.

articles.title: Crypto traders braced for a total wipeout this week but Bitcoin had other plans
articles.snippet: Market experts view bitcoin’s price stability as evidence of its fundamental independence from Washington, maintaining that global liquidity and adoption cycles remain the primary growth drivers.

articles.title: Grayscale’s Zcash ETF files for 3-for-1 forward share split
articles.snippet: At the close of trading on Sept. 28, shareholders will receive two extra shares for each one they hold.
